items: -er (a suffix appended to words to create a masculine noun, usually denoting a profession, performer of an action or a human relation) — писа́ть (“to write”) + -тель → писа́тель (“writer”); предста́вить (“to represent”) + -тель → представи́тель (“representative”)

blocks.text: The stress is usually drawn onto the preceding syllable (but see слу́шатель (“listener”)).
